title: Conserved striatal mechanisms underlying ASD
title_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍背后保守的纹状体机制
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) involves changes in social and stereotypic behaviors regulated by striatal circuitry. Using an innovative cross-species approach, in this issue of Cell, Yuan et al. identify alterations in specific striatal neurons and astrocytes, opening new avenues for investigating cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying striatal dysfunction in ASD.
abstract_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）涉及由纹状体回路调节的社会行为和刻板行为的改变。通过一种创新的跨物种方法，本期Cell杂志中，Yuan等人鉴定了特定纹状体神经元和星形胶质细胞的改变，为研究ASD中纹状体功能障碍的细胞和分子机制开辟了新途径。
